source_text: Voluntary medical male circumcision (VMMC) initiatives, endorsed by WHO in 2007 following randomized controlled trials in Kenya's Kisumu district and Uganda that demonstrated a 51-60% reduction in heterosexual HIV acquisition risk among circumcised men, have targeted low-prevalence areas in East Africa to augment natural rates. [63] [64]
